deadline.value: The EECS PhD pages give no deadline.

gre_general.value: GRE General is required for applicants whose degree is not from an ABET-accredited program.
gre_general.quote: Students with degrees from programs that are not accredited by the ABET engineering or computing commissions must submit scores from the Graduate Record Examination (GRE) general test.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: The page does not state a supervisor rule before admission.

funding.value: Admission and support, including tuition scholarships and assistantships, are competitive.
funding.quote: Admission and support (tuition scholarships, research and teaching assistantships) are competitive.

entry_route.value: Applicants can enter with an M.S. or go straight from a B.S. into the PhD.
entry_route.quote: Admission to the Ph.D. program is considered for applicants who either currently hold an M.S. degree or those who seek direct entry to the Ph.D. program with a B.S. degree.

notes: The EECS PhD name covers computer science, so cs is in also_fields. Admission requirements are on the admissions-requirements page.
